summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature in rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _FileContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads), added 16 tests to tests/test_progress.py, added the "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" docs subsections, and added the CHANGELOG bullet for PR 1759. Edits are additive and nothing was committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run because the task forbids running repository code, so all verification was by reading. Open risks: the mypy suppression on module-level open's return is unconfirmed; the buffering-above-1 passthrough acceptance case has no test; on Python 3.6, typing.IO may make _ProgressReader uninstantiable because mode and name are abstract there.
